name: HP Tonic
description: Heals one member to full HP.

name: Elixir of Insight
description: Grant a small amount of XP to the party.

name: Rear Mirror
description: Reflective glass. Prevents sneak attacks if in back row.

name: Mystic Egg
description: A mysterious egg that pulses with life. Use to hatch.

name: Golden Egg
description: Beautiful golden egg, sought after by many.

name: Radiant Blade Flavio
description: Lucent blade carrying the blessings of the sun.

name: Wind Dancer
description: Leaf-shaped daggers that strike with the speed of wind.

name: Water Scepter
description: Leaf-shaped daggers that strike with the speed of wind.

name: Holy Sword Gram
description: Legendary sword wielded by angels of time immemorial.

name: Dark Scepter Lucille
description: Cursed sceptre. Once wielded by a fallen queen, or so they say.

name: Mars Emblem
description: Its magicked properties imbue the wearer with elemental energy.

name: Mercury Crest
description: Ornate and delicate, its blue sheen is comforting.

name: Hermes' Boots
description: Wondrous boots that grant the wearer unimaginable swiftness.

name: Glittering Teardrop
description: A flawless crystal that catches the faintest light. Alicia believes Laura will love it.

name: Untarnished Signet
description: A heavy golden ring, unmarked and waiting for a new story. Laura can reshape it into something precious.

name: Shattered Blade
description: The rusted, broken remains of a blade that once held great power. The Weaponsmith might be interested.

name: Shattered Edge
description: A masterwork blade reforged from ancient scraps. It hums with latent energy.

name: Meteorite Plate
description: Heavy armor forged from star-metal. Incredibly dense.

name: Mug of Ale
description: Cheap, frothy ale. Refreshes the spirit.

name: Pint of Stout
description: Dark, heavy stout. A meal in a glass.

name: Scrap Plating
description: Barely shaped offcuts, lashed together. It is not nothing.

name: Sludge
description: A thin, bitter draught. Drink it quickly.

name: Burnt Slop
description: Charred beyond identification, and still faintly nourishing.

name: Broken Spring
description: It still has some tension in it. Some.

name: Ambrosia
description: Food of the gods. Restores full HP and MP.

name: Chrysalis Sigil
description: A gilded sigil that unlocks a creature's next evolution. Consumed on promotion.

name: Obsidian Shard
description: A sharp shard of dark volcanic glass that grants a trace of defense.

name: Melted Wax
description: A glob of warm wax that slightly resists Red damage.

name: Ectoplasm
description: Shimmering spirit matter that grants a trace of magic.

name: Warding Charm
description: Shatters to keep its bearer from passing away. Once.

name: Vial of Second Breath
description: Draws the fallen back once the dust settles, then runs dry.

name: Thrice-Blessed Bead
description: Three prayers answered, then only glass.

name: Tome: Wind Blade
description: Teaches Wind Blade to one creature.

name: Black Hinge
description: A rare object that unlocks a particular transformation.

name: Forbidden Lamp

name: Town Portal

name: Crossing Writ
description: A narrow stamped writ authorizing one Summoner to cross St. Maria's Labyrinth gate.
